en.description: Track corporate card payments, scan cash receipts and close your books — all connected through open banking.

landing.headline: Every company expense tracked from card to closing
landing.subheadline: For finance managers who need one place to record corporate cards, scan cash receipts and produce accounting reports.
landing.featuresHeading: Built around how your company actually pays

features.description: See every card transaction as it posts and assign it to the right cost centre without manual entry.

features.title: Cash Receipt Scanning

features.title: Open Banking Sync

features.title: Invoice Matching
features.description: Pair incoming invoices to payments already in the ledger without manual searching through rows.

features.title: Spend Reports & Predictions

features.title: Full Audit Trail

howItWorks.heading: From first payment to closed books

steps.title: Connect your bank
steps.description: Link your company bank account via the open-banking API — no manual file imports or CSV uploads needed.

steps.title: Capture every payment
steps.description: Scan a cash receipt with your phone or let corporate card transactions sync automatically into the ledger.

steps.title: Categorise and approve
steps.description: Assign each expense a cost category and approve it to move it into the accounting ledger for reconciliation.

steps.title: Report and close
steps.description: Export period reports or pass the full ledger to your accountant with a complete audit trail attached.

items.question: Which banks does the open-banking connection support?
items.answer: The system uses the PSD2 open-banking standard. Any bank that exposes a PSD2-compliant API can be connected. Check with your bank whether their open-banking API is currently live.

items.question: Can several employees scan receipts and use corporate cards?
items.answer: Yes. Each employee signs in with their own account. Their submissions appear in the company admin view, where they can be approved or returned for correction.

items.question: How accurate is the receipt scanning?
items.answer: The scanner reads amount, date and vendor from a clear photograph. You review the result before it is saved, so no entry enters the ledger without your confirmation.

items.question: Is my company's financial data stored securely?
items.answer: All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Access requires Google sign-in, and each account sees only its own company's records.

items.question: Can I export data for my accountant?
items.answer: Yes. You can export the expense ledger and period reports. The export includes the original payment source, category and approval status for every entry.

items.question: Ktoré banky open-banking pripojenie podporuje?
items.answer: Systém využíva štandard PSD2. Prepojiť možno každú banku, ktorá sprístupňuje PSD2-kompatibilné API. Overte si u svojej banky, či je ich open-banking API aktívne.

items.question: Môže viac zamestnancov skenovať bloky a používať firemné karty?
items.answer: Áno. Každý zamestnanec sa prihlasuje vlastným účtom. Ich výdavky vidí firemný administrátor, ktorý ich môže schváliť alebo vrátiť na opravu.

items.question: Aká je presnosť skenovania blokov?
items.answer: Skener načíta sumu, dátum a dodávateľa z ostrého odfotografovania. Výsledok si pred uložením skontrolujete, takže do denníka nevstúpi žiadny záznam bez vášho potvrdenia.

items.question: Sú finančné dáta mojej firmy bezpečne uložené?
items.answer: Všetky dáta sú šifrované pri prenose aj v uložisku. Prístup vyžaduje prihlásenie cez Google a každý účet vidí iba dáta svojej firmy.

items.question: Môžem exportovať dáta pre účtovníka?
items.answer: Áno. Môžete exportovať účtovný denník aj periodické výkazy. Export obsahuje pôvodný zdroj platby, kategóriu a stav schválenia pre každý záznam.
